we developed a bi-directionally coupling system for simulation tool s and walkthrough-systems.

the development and the evaluation of a system that enables a bi-directional coupling of a simulation tool and a walkthrough system and ther efore allows a user to examine and understand a simulation process in a 3-dimensional environment.
the development of an architecture which is able to provide a bi-directional visualisation of simulation tools and a 3D walkthrou g system.
the development and the implementation of a distributed walkthrough system which is coupled to a manufacturing simulation system.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present a system which is capable of a bidirectional visualising of simulation processes.
we have successfully realised a b i-directional coupling of simulation tools with a walkthrough system.

a distributed system consisting a commercial manufacturing simulation tool, coupling module and walkthrough system provides the possibility to visualise and interact with the simulation in a virtual environment.

a bi-directional coupling of simulation tools with a walkthrough-system is possible.
